This feedback period will begin on November 1 and remain open until November 30. Additionally, the GST audit process will be streamlined to ensure minimal taxpayer harassment. The updated return forms are set to be applicable from April 1, 2027. Notifications regarding these decisions will be publicly available starting Friday.

sectors.title: BlueStone reports Rs 4.4 crore loss in Q2 as operating revenue rises 45%
sectors.summary: The company’s operating revenue rose 45% year-on-year (YoY) to Rs 745 crore in the second quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 513.6 crore a year earlier. Including other income of Rs 24.4 crore, BlueStone's total income stood at Rs 769 crore during the quarter.

sectors.title: Bridging the AI production gap: Over 100,000 Indian engineers trained to build with Gemini
sectors.summary: India is seeing a significant shift in its technology workforce towards enterprise AI integration and solutions. The Build with Gemini initiative has trained over 100,000 developers and architects across several major organizations. This transition emphasizes the need for professionals skilled in engineering AI for production. Global System Integrators are crucial in facilitating this workforce transformation. The evolution aims to position India as a key player in AI architecture and engineering.

sectors.title: Cognizant acquires DyFlex Solutions to enhance AI and SAP transformation capabilities
sectors.summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions has signed an agreement to acquire DyFlex Solutions, enhancing its AI and SAP capabilities. This acquisition is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals. DyFlex specializes in SAP transformation and is based in Australia and New Zealand. The deal marks Cognizant’s third acquisition in 2026 as it seeks to expand its services.
